about: [cold play] A block of the Tenements on foot by real input: from door to door (the nearest street door not yet tried, walked to, faced, E), a look back down the street at each, then the map.

steps.look: (() => { const d = window.__door, C = N.controller; const ty = Math.atan2(d.nx, d.nz); let a = ty - C.yaw; a = Math.atan2(Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a)); return [Math.round(-a / 0.0021), Math.round((C.pitch + 0.05) / 0.0021)]; })()

steps.eval: (async () => { const p = N.controller.pos; const P = await import('/src/world/plan.js'); const g = G.stage.part('city').graph; const s = g.streetAt(p.x, p.z); return JSON.stringify({x: +p.x.toFixed(1), z: +p.z.toFixed(1), d: P.districtAt(p.x, p.z).id, street: s && s.edge && (s.edge.name || s.edge.street), door: window.__door && {kind: window.__door.kind, place: window.__door.place}, hud: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 120)}); })()
